thread:
Leah: Filing follow-up from Cust-Delta Dedicated outage. Root cause: short spike of control-plane churn caused peering route flaps; combined with on-prem NAT conntrack limits, several worker pods lost connectivity. Short summary + actions below.

Omar: TL;DR owners + ETAs please. Is this new or recurring? :question:

Jin: Recurring pattern. We've seen a similar interaction (route flap + conntrack) at least twice in last 4 months when deploys overlap high client churn.

Priya: Repro note from lab: when simulating 350 concurrent short-lived TCP clients while toggling the peering route, conntrack fills and SYNs silently drop. Kernel snippet: ```
Apr 14 02:11:22 fw kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
Apr 14 02:11:22 fw custom-fw: conntrack overflow threshold met
```

Leah: Proposed owners:
- Omar: peering fallback policy + monitoring (short-term)
- Jin: runbook + reproducibility artifacts (mid)
- Priya: CS comms + customer ETA (short)
- Leah: program lead + exec update (long)

Omar: Short-term actions (today):
- enable regional fallback route for Cust-Delta (rollback plan ready) — ETA 3h
- apply gateway keepalive tuning (tcp_keepalive_time=15) — ETA 1h
- create conntrack headroom alert (80%) — ETA 6h

IncidentBot: Created tickets INC-55810, REM-55811, CS-55812. https://jira.redwood/INC-55810

Jin: Mid/long actions:
- publish NAT pool sizing guidance for Dedicated on-prem installs (ETA 7d)
- add peering-control-plane telemetry (per-customer retransmit & flap rate) (ETA 21d)
- schedule weekly peering stress job in sandpit (ETA 30d)

Priya: Draft customer blurb: "We've applied temporary routing failovers and are implementing a permanent mitigation plan. We'll share a detailed timeline within 7 business days." Approve?

Leah: Good. Make it explicit that we're not seeing data plane corruption and that we're prioritizing a fix. ETA for customer comms: 45m.

Omar: Cross-customer task: correlate BGP flap events with control-plane deploy windows across Dedicated customers for last 180 days. Owner: Omar. ETA 2025-05-10.

Jin: Repro command to attach to runbook: ```
# quick synth churn
for i in {1..400}; do timeout 1 bash -c "</dev/tcp/${PEER_IP}/$((1024 + i % 2000))" & done; sleep 2; dmesg | tail -n 50 | grep conntrack
```

Priya: Adding runbook note: "Validate conntrack headroom and NAT pool sizing before Dedicated cutover."

Leah: Nice. Add any missing items to the Jira tickets. We'll review in the peering cadence slot next week; escalate to #eng-oncall if you hit blockers. Closing thread after cadence notes posted. :thumbsup:
